post.title: Saga Pattern: Coordinating Distributed Transactions with Compensation
post.subtitle: Model long-running workflows with compensating actions instead of fragile global transactions.
post.brief: A Saga replaces fragile distributed 2PC with a sequence of local transactions, each backed by an explicit compensating transaction. Use orchestration when workflow control needs a single brain; use choreography when services must stay loosely coupled.
